column1: # ZAP alerts the app accepts (scripts/zap.sh, CI: security-scan.yml). Format: rule id, IGNORE/WARN/FAIL, reason.

column3: (Cookie Poisoning) ?lang= only accepts en, de, fr, it
(User Controllable HTML Element Attribute) ?lang= is checked against en, de, fr, it; output is escaped
(Session Management Response Identified) informational: the session and OAuth state cookies
(Suspicious Comments) comments in the app's own script, nothing secret
(Non-Storable Content) informational: pages are private (Cache-Control: no-cache, private) on purpose
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy) the app embeds nothing from other sites; no cross-origin isolation needed
